v: Naive synthetic market (no historical Kalshi prices archive); P&L is an UPPER BOUND vs what real Kalshi market makers would price.
P&L assumes the model can always trade at the displayed bid/ask; real fills are subject to liquidity + queue position.
Brier improvement is the more invariant metric than P&L when comparing across stations.

brier_ndfd is computed against NBM-deterministic Tmax wrapped in a per-fold-fitted Gaussian sigma (not true NBM probabilistic qmd). See docs/research/NDFD-BENCHMARK-SOURCE.md for the source decision and the upgrade path. Phase 5 readiness criterion #2 should be re-checked against true qmd before going live.
n_evaluated_with_ndfd may be < n_evaluated because Open-Meteo's NBM history starts ~2024-11; pre-archive folds carry NaN.
